Definition: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to put, place, set, appoint, make; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to put, set, lay, put or lay upon, lay (violent) hands on; 1a2) to set, direct, direct toward; 1a2a) to extend (compassion) (fig); 1a3) to set, ordain, establish, found, appoint, constitute, make, determine, fix; 1a4) to set, station, put, set in place, plant, fix; 1a5) to make, make for, transform into, constitute, fashion, work, bring to pass, appoint, give; 1b) (Hiphil) to set or make for a sign; 1c) (Hophal) to be set
